court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Bandra - Case No. A-640 of 2014
case_name: Mr. Vishwajeet Gaurishankar Roy vs Mrs. Varsha Yadav
facts_of_case: The husband filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, which was dismissed by the Family Court. The husband appealed to this court.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes through mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: Both the parties have agreed to resolve all their disputes and put an end to the matter through decree of divorce as well as consequent litigations between the parties pending before different Courts including the present appeal & case no. RCC/1101552/2012 lodged by Nerul Police Station against the Appellant and his parents.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to a one-time settlement in lieu of ongoing litigation.
legal_principles.held: Pursuant to the protracted mutual discussions between the parties held in the presence of the Mediator on 01.10.2022, both the parties have agreed to resolve all their disputes and put an end to the matter through decree of divorce as well as consequent litigations between the parties pending before different Courts including the present appeal & case no. RCC/1101552/2012 lodged by Nerul Police Station against the Appellant and his parents.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to modify a decree of the Family Court.
legal_principles.held: The parties have agreed that the Appellant would pay an amount of Rs.11,00,000/- as one time permanent settlement towards the alimony to the Respondent - wife and expenses for the education, maintenance and marriage of the daughter Ashita.

outcome.final_order: The parties agreed for divorce by mutual consent on terms and conditions settled between them.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce by mutual consent
advising on mediation in family disputes
preparing an appeal against a Family Court order
